name: [DEPRECATED] Small Cases - Now With Fannypack!
teaser: A collection of small cases to make the early game a little less tedious, and a custom fannypack that can go into the third special slot for extended inventory jankiness! Hurry, while supplies last!
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
THIS MOD IS NO LONGER BEING UPDATED

Please use the new version here for 380: WTT - Pack ‘n’ Strap

Install Instructions:

- This mod has ZERO requirements!

- Simply drag the users folder from the download into your main SPT folder! If you did everything correct you should have two new mods in your users/mods directory, zFannyPack and zSmallCases!

Are you tired of slogging through the same old grind in the treacherous world of Escape from Tarkov? Well, buckle up, because have I got a deal for you! Introducing the mod that will revolutionize your early game experience!

Get ready for the ultimate upgrade, folks, because we’re introducing not one, not two, but EIGHT mind-blowing new cases! These cases are the answer to all your early game woes, making your journey through Tarkov a breeze!

  • Small Ammopouch: A small pouch that has a 3x2 internal grid to store ammunition. (Prapor sells this at level 1)
  • Small Docscase: A small docscase with a 2x4 internal grid to store documents, money, and keycards. (Therapist sells this at level 1)
  • Small Keychain: A small keyring with a 2x3 internal grid to store keys. (Therapist sells this at level 1)
  • Lunchbox: A luncbox with a 3x3 internal grid to store your food and drinks. (Jaegar sells this at level 1)
  • Medicine Pouch: A medicine pouch with a 3x4 internal grid to store all your meds. (Therapist sells this at level 1)
  • Magdump Pouch: A small pouch with a 4x4 internal grid to store your mags. (Prapor sells this at level 1)
  • Toolcase: A toolcase with a 4x3 internal grid to store all your tools. (Mechanic sells this at level 1)
  • Small Scavcase: A small case with a 8x5 internal grid to store all your junk. (Therapist sells this at level 1)

All of these cases are added to traders, and added to assault, usec, and bear loot.

But wait, there’s more! If you take action right now, we’re throwing in a bonus item that will leave you in awe: the one and only Fannypack! That’s right, folks, the Fannypack is your secret weapon for carrying all that precious loot in style! It’s like having a portable treasure chest strapped to your hip!

  • Fannypack: A slick pouch with a 2x6 internal grid. Great way to hold all these new cases, or anything you want really. (Ragman sells this at level 1)

What sets the fannypack aside from the rest is it can go in the third special slot! The fannypack now works as a (janky) extension to the player inventory, allowing you to see half of the inventory of the fannypack without opening it.

NOTE: THIS IS INTENDED JANKINESS. The way BSG coded these slots is the same exact way a backpack or chestrig slot works, when you put the item inside the slot the inventory appears automatically. Because of where those slots are, placing the bag in slot 1 or 2 would overlap slot 3. By putting it in slot 3, you won’t be overlapping any slots but you WILL have half of the Fannypack overlapped by the inventory screen. (see image above)

You can still open the bag inventory by double clicking on it/right click and open. I wish I could move the inventory of the Fannypack slightly to the left, but that’s beyond my means lol. So for now, we get half of a new backpack added to our inventory.

As far as insurance is concerned, it’s a little weird and honestly needs more testing lol. Some items will stay with you on death like a secure case, other items are lost on death. Here is an example I just tested:
I had the Fannypack with each of the small cases containing one or two items. out of everything I packed (key in the keytool, water in the lunchbox, keycard money and key in the docs, ammo in the ammopouch, and a grizzly in the medpouch) I only lost the keys and keycard on death. I am in NO WAY guaranteeing you won’t lose items in the Fannypack, but there is a chance lol. Only put items that are expendable in the Fannypack, I am NOT responsible for you losing all your keys because you didn’t read this description lol.

The Fannypack is added to usec, bear, pmcbot, and assault bots.

Big shoutout to Jehree’s custom case framework for doing all the legwork! All I did was tweak a few things to add special slot support (thanks to jbs4bmx Special Slots), and ended up making the case framework support multiple cases so this mod didn’t need to be 6 separate folders lol.

NONE of this would have been possible without SSH’s SDK and tutorials, I would have been absolutely lost making any of this without guidance lol.

KNOWN BUGS:
- The Fannypack appears on the character when in the backpack slot, but does NOT appear when in the specials slot.

PLANNED FEATURES:
- More cases, possibly larger variants? If you have any suggestions leave a comment!

- Find a way to display the fannypack while it is in the special slot

- Find a way to move the inventory screen for the fannypack so it doesn’t clip.
